name: Berrywitched! The Harvest
source:
In this game, you follow Strawberry as she finally gets the chance to leave her pocket dimension, and uncover the truth behind why she was sent there in the first place…

[Edited from [url=https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/berrywitched-the-harvest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将跟随草莓，因为她终于有机会离开她的口袋维度，并揭开她最初被送到那里的真相……

[编辑自[url=https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/berrywitched-the-harvest]itch.io[/url]]
